thread:
ryan: runtime-monitor flagged failing image loads after last night's base rebuild: redwood/base-runtime:2026-04-02
priya: Quick SBOM shows zlib v1.2.13 (CVE-2026-2100) present. Did the rebase pull in a vulnerable upstream?
anya: Rebase PR updated zlib intentionally; release notes said 1.2.14 but build produced 1.2.13 due to a transitive pin.
kevin: Ouch. Also cosign verify shows the tag is signed by ci-baker, but KMS rotation ran last night — need to ensure future signs succeed.
marta: Ops rotated signing key v7 -> v8 at 03:00 UTC. I did not see any requester attach step for the new version. I'll add a note to CL-4600.
priya: For immediate mitigation: 1) quarantine the tag from prod pulls, 2) rebuild minimal layer with zlib=1.2.14, 3) sign with explicit key version, 4) run staging canary.
infra-bot: Quarantine rule applied: redwood/base-runtime:2026-04-02 -> quarantined.
ryan: Good. Marta, can you attach ci-baker to v8 with a conditional binding scoped to infra project and TTL 24h? We want least privilege while we rebuild.
marta: Adding binding now with condition `request.time < timestamp_plus(24h)` and `requester='infra'`. Creating infra-change CL-4601.
priya: Rebuild started: `bazel run //images:base-runtime -- --update-package zlib=1.2.14 --minimize`
kevin: Note for long term: add a rotation post-check that runs `cosign verify` against a dummy tag to confirm signer principal still works. Fail rotation if check fails.
anya: Also enforce SBOM gate on base-image PRs so we don't merge transitive downgrades accidentally.
priya: Rebuild done. Signing attempt using explicit version path `.../cryptoKeys/runtime-sign/cryptoKeyVersions/8` -> success. `cosign verify` OK.
infra-bot: Quarantine lifted after replacement push. Old tag moved to quarantine/archive/2026-04-02.
ryan: Canary in staging healthy 20m. Promoting. Filing postmortem ticket PM-801 with follow-ups: rotation-check automation, SBOM PR gate, and infra rotation docs. Closing thread.
